_comment.::: Place this file in / and replace all instances of [placeholder]
_comment.Values::APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_S: Required, specifies the connection string for Application Insights
_comment.Values::AzureWebJobsStorage: Required, specifies the connection string of web jobs for Storage
_comment.Values::FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME: Required, specifies the value of the worker runtime for Functions
_comment.Values::IGDB_API_ACCESS_TOKEN: Required, specifies the access token for the IGDB API
_comment.Values::IGDB_API_CLIENT_ID: Required, specifies the client ID for the IGDB API
_comment.Values::MONGODB_URI: Required, specifies the URI connection string for MongoDB (use {database-placeholder} instead of specifying a database name)
_comment.Values::ServiceBusConnection: Required, specifies the shared access signature with send and listen claims for Service Bus
_comment.Values::SERVICE_BUS_NAMESPACE: Required, specifies the namespace for Service Bus
_comment.Values::SERVICE_BUS_QUEUE_NAME_IGDB_API_: Required, specifies the queue name of IGDB API webhook for Service Bus
_comment.Values::WEBHOOK_CALLBACK_URL: Required, specifies the callback URL for webhooks
